question: What home services have been done within half a mile of 4512 Live Oak St, Dallas, TX 75204 in the last 24 months, grouped by trade?
derivation: Derived from the raw data pack by a separate pass that never read the implementation. Every record in the three CRMs and the CSV log was geocoded by parsing <number> <street> <suffix>, normalizing the suffix, matching unknown street names to the reference street names (similarity >= 0.75, unique best), inferring a missing zip when the reference street exists in exactly one zip, and interpolating t = (number - from_number) / 100 along the matching street_segments block. Distance is haversine (R = 6,371,008.8 m) from 4512 Live Oak St 75204; kept when <= 804.7 m. Kept kind job (estimates excluded), canonical status completed (cancelled and limbo excluded), end time (start if no end; the CSV date) in [2024-11-02 00:00, 2026-11-02 00:00) America/Chicago. Exact duplicate CSV rows count once; all visits of one Jobber job count once (unit = job). Calendar events add no history (every past calendar job mirrors a CRM or CSV record). Trade = the provider profile trade; for the one two-trade provider (Peak Home Services: handyman + painting) a job is painting when its text mentions paint/cabinet/stain/trim, otherwise handyman. Total 1,007 jobs; by source: Housecall Pro 530, Jobber 364, Workiz 94, CSV 19. Inside the radius and window, 120 estimates, 106 cancelled and 6 limbo items are excluded.
tolerance: Each trade count must lie in [min, max]. min is the count without zip inference and fuzzy street matching (the strict lower bound); max is the expected count, plus 1 for hvac and pest where a record sits within 2 m of the half-mile line (804.698 m, 806.56 m), so the radius convention (804.7 m vs 804.672 m) cannot fail the answer. Handyman and painting may be split differently for Peak Home Services: either both are in range or their sum is in [combinedMin, combinedMax]. A trade not listed here with a non-zero count fails (no keyword re-mapping of trades). Visit-level counting (cleaning 680) and dropping the CSV log (handyman -19) fail by these ranges. jobIds lists the expected job source record IDs per trade; the harness reports recall against them as a note only, because the record ID format is the implementation's choice.
